import pytest
from inventory.stock import StockItem, reserve_stock, InsufficientInventoryError


def test_overdraw_is_rejected():
    item = StockItem(sku="SKU-01", available=10)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientInventoryError):
        reserve_stock(item, 11)
    assert item.available == 10
explanation: Requests one more than available and asserts reserve_stock rejects the overdraw with stock unchanged. No existing test requests more than available, which is why weakening the comparison survived.
rationale: pytest.raises(InsufficientInventoryError) on an over-available request is the assertion that detects the weakened comparison.
